criteria.question: is the sine-song neuron DNp13 reachable at all in this model (D1), and does pC1_1b drive sine over pulse (D2)?
criteria.source: Current Biology 36:4697-4716 (2026): pC1_1b acts on DNp13 and takes 13% of input from LC10a
criteria.rule: best_input = type with largest cholinergic synapse count onto DNp13 (DNp13 excluded)

protocol.arms: best_input, pC1_1b, and LC10a (every LC10a* type present; reported)
protocol.model: declared parameter set (LIFParams), electrical synapses on

D1_dnp13_reachable.rule: DNp13 spikes/cell/pulse under best_input at 100 Hz, bootstrap over pulses: PASS if the 95% interval lies at or above 0.5

D2_pc1_1b_sine_choice.rule: conjunction, pC1_1b at 100 Hz: (a) DNp13 spikes/cell/pulse, bootstrap over pulses, 95% interval at or above 0.5; (b) DNp13 minus pMP2 paired per pulse, bootstrap over pulses, 95% interval strictly above 0; PASS only if both parts pass

interpretation.D1_only: pC1_14a selectivity genuine; pC1_1b link not reproduced
interpretation.D1_fail: reword pc1_song P1/P2: pulse driven, sine unreachable

electrical: shakB gap junction, 1:1 relay; Tanouye & Wyman 1980; Allen et al. 2006
shakB gap junction, 1:1 relay; Allen et al. 2006; Phelan et al. 2008
JON->GF mixed synapse modelled as electrical; shakB-dependent (Pezier et al. 2016); mixed (Pezier et al. 2014); 3 mV target untraced; contact set from MaleCNS v1.0
JON->GF mixed synapse modelled as electrical; shakB-dependent (Pezier et al. 2016); mixed (Pezier et al. 2014); 3 mV target untraced; contact set from MaleCNS v1.0
intrinsic: all-or-none GF response; von Reyn 2014; Ache 2019. Fitted by pre-stated rule (smallest value giving 1-2 spikes/response, <=2 on the strongest gain quartile, P(response) 0.5-1, TTMn relay intact; benchmarks/fit_gf_adapt.py at >=40 trials). 10 mV under the measured stationary loom input (refit 2026-10-10, 40 trials; the strong-quartile constraint holds at 1.95, close to its limit of 2). Earlier 30 mV was fitted under the all-trials input; a 15 mV value came from an undersampled 20-trial fit. 0 mV gives up to 7 spikes per loom.
sustained MN rates < 100 Hz; Azevedo 2020; McKellar 2020
